name: inventory
description: Items that may appear in a character inventory

fields.Name: Coil of rope
fields.Description: Ten meters of sturdy rope for climbing, binding, or securing loads.

fields.Name: Lantern and oil
fields.Description: A hooded lantern with enough oil for several hours.

fields.Name: Three travel rations
fields.Description: Compact food sufficient for three days.

fields.Name: Waterskin
fields.Description: A filled leather waterskin.

fields.Name: Bedroll
fields.Description: A weather-resistant blanket and sleeping roll.

fields.Name: Tinderbox
fields.Description: Flint, steel, and dry tinder for starting fires.

fields.Name: Lockpicking kit
fields.Description: Small tools for manipulating ordinary mechanical locks.

fields.Name: Climbing kit
fields.Description: Pitons, a hammer, straps, and simple climbing aids.

fields.Name: Bandages
fields.Description: Clean cloth and basic supplies for treating wounds.

fields.Name: Chalk and charcoal
fields.Description: Useful for marking paths, sketching maps, and making notes.

fields.Name: Small mirror
fields.Description: A polished hand mirror useful for signals and checking corners.

fields.Name: Crowbar
fields.Description: A sturdy iron lever for doors, crates, and obstacles.

fields.Name: Grappling hook
fields.Description: A four-pronged hook designed for use with rope.

fields.Name: Fishing kit
fields.Description: Line, hooks, floats, and a compact net.

fields.Name: Writing kit
fields.Description: Ink, quills, parchment, sealing wax, and a protective case.

fields.Name: Herbalism pouch
fields.Description: Small tools and containers for gathering useful plants.

fields.Name: Shovel
fields.Description: A compact but sturdy digging tool.

fields.Name: Antidote
fields.Description: A general treatment granting another chance to resist ordinary poison.

fields.Name: Smoke bomb
fields.Description: Creates a dense cloud of smoke when ignited.

fields.Name: Bear trap
fields.Description: A heavy mechanical trap capable of restraining a creature.

fields.Name: Disguise kit
fields.Description: Cosmetics, dyes, false hair, and simple costume pieces.

fields.Name: Merchant's scale
fields.Description: A folding balance and reference weights for checking trade goods.

fields.Name: Bag of caltrops
fields.Description: Sharp metal spikes used to slow pursuit or secure a passage.

fields.Name: Vial of basic poison
fields.Description: A limited dose of toxin suitable for one weapon or drink.

fields.Name: Spyglass
fields.Description: A compact optical tube for viewing distant details.

fields.Name: Tent
fields.Description: A small shelter suitable for one or two travelers.

fields.Name: Manacles
fields.Description: A pair of iron restraints with a simple key.

fields.Name: Holy symbol
fields.Description: A symbol tied to a faith, oath, ancestor, or personal ideal.

fields.Name: Local map
fields.Description: A practical but imperfect map of the surrounding region.

fields.Name: Potion of night vision
fields.Description: Grants clear sight in darkness for one hour.

fields.Name: Potion of water breathing
fields.Description: Allows underwater breathing for thirty minutes.

fields.Name: Acid flask
fields.Description: A carefully sealed vial able to damage common materials.

fields.Name: Silvered chain
fields.Description: A short chain useful against creatures vulnerable to silver.

fields.Name: Runic chalk
fields.Description: Rare chalk that makes magical inscriptions easier to see and study.

fields.Name: Whispering compass
fields.Description: A strange compass that quietly complains whenever it points north.

fields.Name: Everlasting candle
fields.Description: A candle whose small flame never consumes its wax.

fields.Name: Unidentified rune fragment
fields.Description: A piece of magical material containing part of an unknown inscription.

fields.Name: Mysterious sealed letter
fields.Description: A letter addressed to someone the character has never met.

fields.Name: Coin Purse
fields.Description: Local currency mixing common small coins with harder-to-spend foreign money.

fields.Name: Healing Potion
fields.Description: A stabilized vial that aids recovery from an injury when used correctly.

fields.Name: Vigor Potion
fields.Description: A drink briefly improving physical ability before causing severe fatigue.

fields.Name: RULE Scroll
fields.Description: A single-use medium that triggers one specific RULE without learning it.

fields.Name: RULE Book
fields.Description: A rare treatise explaining a RULE, its uses, and the risks of misinterpretation.

fields.Name: Excavation Tools
fields.Description: A hook, small pick, and folding shovel for searching or crossing difficult ground.

fields.Name: Unknown Key
fields.Description: A key with no known lock, marked by a symbol tied to an organization or building.

fields.Name: Coded Notes
fields.Description: Pages whose meaning depends on a code, missing context, or absent person.

fields.Name: Specialized Ammunition
fields.Description: A small batch of projectiles made for a particular weapon or unusual target.

fields.Name: Precious Jewel
fields.Description: An identifiable piece of jewelry, portable but risky to resell.

fields.Name: Elemental Essence
fields.Description: An unstable substance retaining properties of a natural or magical element.

fields.Name: Treasure Map
fields.Description: An incomplete route with old landmarks, warnings, and an ambiguous destination.

fields.Name: Quality Paper
fields.Description: Blank sheets and parchment suited to contracts, maps, spells, or forged documents.

fields.Name: Ceremonial Doll
fields.Description: A cloth figure bearing an erased name and traces of an old ritual.

fields.Name: Locked Grimoire
fields.Description: A book protected by a lock or riddle whose contents cannot be read directly.

fields.Name: Old Toy
fields.Description: A toy or stuffed bear recognizable to a family, collector, or spirit.

fields.Name: Creature Fragment
fields.Description: A preserved scale, hide, horn, or tooth kept as trophy, proof, or component.

fields.Name: Rare Medicine
fields.Description: A fragile, hard-to-replace treatment for one specific illness.

fields.Name: Medicinal Plant
fields.Description: A fresh plant whose effectiveness depends on preparation and preservation.

fields.Name: Alchemical Ingredient
fields.Description: An unusual organic component such as a toad eye or venom gland.

fields.Name: Work of Art
fields.Description: A painting, sculpture, or decoration with recognizable cultural value.

fields.Name: Ceremonial Clothing
fields.Description: A robe, cloak, boots, or gloves associated with a rank or institution.

fields.Name: Unfinished Crown
fields.Description: A symbol of authority missing a gem, inscription, or essential piece.

fields.Name: Musical Instrument
fields.Description: A portable lute, drum, violin, or other worn but functional instrument.

fields.Name: Ornate Comb
fields.Description: A personal item decorated with a discreet crest or intimate inscription.

fields.Name: Incomplete Manuscript
fields.Description: A historical or scientific text with pages deliberately removed.

fields.Name: Sealed Vase
fields.Description: A fragile container whose contents produce an unusual sound or warmth.

fields.Name: Exotic Fruit
fields.Description: A rare fruit whose seed, flavor, or properties interest several buyers.

fields.Name: Collectible Figurine
fields.Description: One piece of a sought-after series, trivial alone but valuable to the right person.

fields.Name: Enchanted Toothbrush
fields.Description: An absurdly specific tool that cleans teeth perfectly and bites other dirt.

fields.Name: Unidentified Egg
fields.Description: A living egg whose species, needs, and danger remain unknown.

fields.Name: Attuned Stone
fields.Description: A mineral or magical stone reacting to a place, person, or particular RULE.

fields.Name: Travel Chicken
fields.Description: An unusually calm chicken trained to follow its carrier and signal certain creatures.
